global_policy.board_approval_policy: Freeze a recorded art-direction and calibration judgment before base batches. Record model judgments as model judgments; independent human labels remain a separate later gate.
global_policy.calibration_policy: One calibration character plus action test per board before any base batch on that board. Bases are gated on the recorded calibration judgment. All calibrations pending.
global_policy.conditioning_note: Research access to a publisher storefront screenshot does not grant permission to upload it for generation or training. Cleared images or original Muse-generated design anchors are required wherever conditioning pixels are needed.

finite_limits_corpus_pilot.note: 96 base/variant calls plus 16 calibration calls; all calls also count against the frozen USD 200 corpus ceiling.

finite_limits_per_base.note: 3 calls = 1 base call plus at most 2 model-made repair/negative variants. All limits finite and frozen pre-generation.
finite_limits_per_base.pixels_per_clip: 512x512 px per frame, max 48 frames (12,582,912 px)

repair_policy.note: At most two model-made repair/negative variants per base, counted inside the finite per-base call/time/spend limits.

global_policy.unknown_outcome_policy: Capture unknown provider outcomes without blind retries.

background_separation.analysis: Hypothesis: actors separate from background by value contrast and dark outline bands, keeping tiny sprites legible over busy tilework; to verify per reference.

contour_silhouette.analysis: Hypothesis: chunky few-pixel silhouettes with one dominant readable shape (prow, scarf, helmet horn); detail sacrificed for long-distance readability.

effect_language.analysis: Hypothesis: compact geometric effects (square sparkles, short slash arcs, ring puffs) in high-value hues that clear within a few frames.

holds.analysis: Hypothesis: short holds (2-4 frames) on anticipation and impact poses; idle holds longer with a single moving accent (hair, scarf).

keypose_exaggeration.analysis: Hypothesis: anticipation crouches and shovel-swing extremes pushed beyond functional need so intent reads at tiny sizes.

palette_value.analysis: Hypothesis: restrained per-sprite palettes with a strict value hierarchy (actor brightest or darkest element on screen); saturated accents reserved for interactive elements.

secondary_motion.analysis: Hypothesis: hair, scarves and capes simulated in 2-3 beat-delayed pixel offsets rather than full simulation.

shading_material.analysis: Hypothesis: flat fills with single-shadow-step clusters; material read comes from hue choice rather than rendered lighting.

shape_proportions.analysis: Hypothesis: compact big-head proportions with oversized tools/weapons as the primary identity carrier.

transitions.analysis: Hypothesis: minimal inbetweens with snappy 1-2 frame transitions; motion smears used sparingly for fast arcs.

boards.reference_coverage: Initial subset: games.json screenshot indices 0-3 (4 refs). Indices 4-7 exist in games.json and are not yet curated.

background_separation.analysis: Hypothesis: figure and ground share washes with separation by edge hardness: hard figure edges float over soft bleeding backgrounds.

contour_silhouette.analysis: Hypothesis: soft or absent outlines; silhouettes defined by wash edges and negative space, delicate and light.

effect_language.analysis: Hypothesis: effects are washes, blooms, petals and birds: pigment behavior as motion, dissolving rather than impacting.

holds.analysis: Hypothesis: long contemplative holds (statue poses, gazes) with slow drift; stillness itself is the emotional beat.

keypose_exaggeration.analysis: Hypothesis: minimal exaggeration: poses stay naturalistic and small; emotion carried by color change and scale of surroundings.

palette_value.analysis: Hypothesis: evolving limited palettes per chapter (monochrome into single-hue worlds); color itself narrates progression.

secondary_motion.analysis: Hypothesis: dress, hair and fabric flow continuously like underwater motion; everything drifts, nothing snaps.

shading_material.analysis: Hypothesis: watercolor transparency and granulation as the material language; no cel shadow, only pigment density.

shape_proportions.analysis: Hypothesis: small delicate figure against vast geometric architecture; scale contrast is the primary compositional device.

transitions.analysis: Hypothesis: fluid morphing transitions (figure into bird, dress into sand) with many soft inbetweens; hard cuts avoided.

approval.note: Approval must be a recorded human decision; it is not invented here.

background_separation.analysis: Hypothesis: warm painted ship and island scenery with soft depth haze; characters separated by clean dark linework over lighter grounds.

contour_silhouette.analysis: Hypothesis: fluid hand-drawn contours with varied line weight; anthropomorphic animal silhouettes distinct by ears, antlers and posture.

effect_language.analysis: Hypothesis: gentle glows, blossoms and light trails; effects signify care and passage rather than impact.

holds.analysis: Hypothesis: long emotional holds (hugs, gazes, waves) with breathing and blink micro-motion; acting beats given time.

keypose_exaggeration.analysis: Hypothesis: acting exaggeration over action exaggeration: embraces, slumps and delighted hops pushed for emotional clarity.

palette_value.analysis: Hypothesis: warm sunset palette with teal-shadow complement; food and flora carry saturated accents against calm grounds.

secondary_motion.analysis: Hypothesis: coats, scarves, ears and tails in continuous layered motion; cooking steam and laundry add ambient secondary life.

shading_material.analysis: Hypothesis: soft painted shading with visible brush feel; fur and fabric differentiated by stroke texture.

shape_proportions.analysis: Hypothesis: varied body types across species (tall deer, broad lion, small cat) with consistent hand-drawn construction.

transitions.analysis: Hypothesis: acting transitions eased with many inbetweens; hugs and hand-offs staged so contact reads through occlusion.

approval.note: Approval must be a recorded human decision; it is not invented here.

boards.reference_coverage: Initial subset: games.json screenshot indices 0-3 per game (8 refs). Remaining indices (both games 4-7) exist in games.json and are not yet curated.

background_separation.analysis: Hypothesis: readable combat stages with strong foreground silhouettes; Skullgirls uses flat graphic backdrops, SoR4 painterly streets, both keeping fighters forward by contrast.

contour_silhouette.analysis: Hypothesis: bold heavy contours around fighter anatomy; silhouettes communicate stance, guard and attack direction instantly.

effect_language.analysis: Hypothesis: hard graphic impact stars, speed arcs and screen shake cues; effects punctuate hits with high-contrast shapes.

holds.analysis: Hypothesis: hit-stop impact holds (2-4f) plus long victory/taunt holds; anticipation crouches held to telegraph.

keypose_exaggeration.analysis: Hypothesis: extreme key poses at anticipation, impact and recovery; Skullgirls pushes cartoon extremes, SoR4 weighty brawler realism.

palette_value.analysis: Hypothesis: bold saturated fighters against darker or complementary stages; hit flashes to white for impact registration.

secondary_motion.analysis: Hypothesis: jackets, hair and accessories whip on hit reactions; cloth and hair sell impact alongside body motion.

shading_material.analysis: Hypothesis: strong cel shading with crisp shadow shapes; muscle and denim rendered in graphic value steps.

shape_proportions.analysis: Hypothesis: distinct body types per fighter (heavy, fast, grappler) with exaggerated fists, feet and hair as identity markers.

transitions.analysis: Hypothesis: cancel-style snappy transitions between combat states with smear and afterimage frames bridging hits.
